# Remaining Work — Do All Unified Movie System

The Awtsmoos renews each frame and every creative gate; Awtsmoos.com shall reveal one movie covenant whose many studios collaborate.

## Primary completion graph
1. Stabilize the canonical `apps/shared/movie` public API, protocol constants, validation and migration path.
2. Extend the movie vocabulary with media, audio, dialogue, captions, masks, adjustments, camera tracks and data semantics.
3. Add reversible canonical patch operations for surgical AI and human revisions.
4. Add provider-aware AI planning/revision interfaces plus deterministic fallback generation.
5. Add cast continuity, character action/pose/emotion/gaze/lipsync metadata and duration-aware scene planning.
6. Standardize all app adapters and retire duplicate authoritative paths without destroying compatibility.
7. Build cross-app fidelity reports and round-trip-safe canonical preservation.
8. Replace the raw JSON-only mobile dock with prompt/storyboard/timeline/canvas/export directing surfaces.
9. Add shared timeline/undo command concepts that both humans and AI can invoke reversibly.
10. Expand the deterministic Canvas proof renderer for richer media semantics while preserving low-end fallback.
11. Define spatial renderer interfaces for true 3D engines without coupling the protocol to one implementation.
12. Add asset registry/provenance/proxy/hash contracts.
13. Add deterministic export manifests, quality profiles and render verification utilities.
14. Add shared-core unit, integration, adapter, AI, migration, patch and render tests.
15. Build a real exactly-180-second acceptance movie using recurring characters, 2D/3D, charts, text, paths, particles, tutorials and multiple camera styles.
16. Render actual media through an existing production-capable path or the strongest deterministic fallback available.
17. Verify duration, dimensions, nontrivial frame diversity and runtime/browser/mobile behavior.
18. Re-read every touched file, run indentation/minification/JSDoc/Awtsmoos checks, compare planned versus actual and close every safe remaining item.
